title: Hong Kong — Anti-Extradition Protests 2019
description: Protestas masivas contra ley de extradición. 2M personas marcharon. Elecciones de distrito mostraron dividedo polarizado.
sources: HKU POP (Hong Kong University Public Opinion Programme)
Cheng & Yip (2020): Hong Kong protest dynamics
data_notes: P represents polarization_index (units: index). Series reconstructed from published research sources (empirical_estimated). Observation operator H: std(opinion) / 1.0. At Tier 1 (< 500 observations), only aggregate parameters can be calibrated against this case; see docs/validation/PROMPT_CALIBRACION_EQUIPO_AGENTES.md.
observation_operator_description: Polarization index: P rises with anti-extradition movement intensity. Observation operator H: std(opinion_dimension) normalized by half-range.
